ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to FSHN majors and minors only. FSHN minors must contact the department office for registration authorization (333-1324). Outside majors will register in section 52117 and will be assessed a class materials fee of $30. For registration authorization, outside majors should e-mail fshn-general@ad.uiuc.edu with "FSHN 302" in the subject line. TO BE ADDED TO A WAIT LIST FOR THIS CLASS, go to www.fshn.uiuc.edu and click on "Info for Current Students" and then on øWaitlist Information.ø
